summary: A 100-ft steel lookout in Lewis County, Tennessee, with no build date on record; its last visit report (2006) found it unstaffed, unused and behind a fenced access road.

facts.design: 100-ft steel tower with diagonal stair (per 2006 visit report)
facts.status_note: Listed as standing on the Tennessee Landforms list; the only visit report on the register is from 2006 and describes poor wood condition and removed bottom landings.

access.note: 2006 visit: fence across the access road with no trespassing signs; the site may be private land. Current access not verified.

visit.trail_note: Two bottom landings removed to prevent climbing (2006 visit). Tower sits just off a paved road and is visible from the highway; the access road is fenced.

events.note: Visit report by Jerry Lutes: not in use for a good number of years; bottom two landings removed to prevent climbing; poor wood condition; unstaffed

evidence.supports: just off paved road, visible from highway in pines
evidence.quote: Tower is just off paved road and is easily seen from Highway in a stand of tall pine trees.

evidence.supports: not used for a good number of years
evidence.quote: It appears that tower has not been in use for a good number of years.

evidence.supports: bottom landings removed to prevent climbing
evidence.quote: Tower has two bottom landings removed to prevent climbing.
Overall wood condition looks poor - several missing boards on landings.
There is a small old TN Dept of Forestry shed (10 x 12) on site, which is locked.

evidence.supports: possible private land; fence and no-trespassing signs
evidence.quote: site may be on private propety, fence across access road with no trespassing signs.

evidence.supports: 2006 visit report dated March 4, 2006 by Jerry Lutes
standing per Tennessee Landforms tower list

notes_for_editor: No build date, builder or designing agency found in the sources read (NHLR detail page has no Built field). The agency is not established: the 2006 visit notes a TN Dept of Forestry sign and locked shed on site, but no administration statement was found, so no agency fact is recorded. The only physical description is a 2006 visit report; the Tennessee Landforms list (undated snapshot) shows it standing. Access was inferred from the fence and no-trespassing signs in that 2006 report, so the level is restricted pending a current source. The 100-ft height is the visit report's figure, converted to 30.5 m. OpenStreetMap tags it tower:construction=lattice; not used because it is user-edited and does not give a date.
